deadline.value: Apply by December 1 for admission the following September; no Spring admission under normal circumstances.
deadline.quote: The application deadline is December 1 of each calendar year for admission in September of the following year.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not used for admission and should not be submitted.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are not used for determining admission and should not be submitted.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores, including subject tests, are not used for admission and should not be submitted.
gre_subject.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are not used for determining admission and should not be submitted.

funding.value: Admitted students are normally supported through their fifth year via assistantships, training grants and fellowships.
funding.quote: Students accepted into the NSB Program are normally supported through their fifth year in residence.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is required for admission; no master's is needed.
entry_route.quote: Completion of a bachelor's degree is required for admission to graduate study.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Strong life-science preparation is expected; interviews are held for strong international applicants.
